purpose: Improve candidate quality using DEV-only feedback from E9 without touching VALIDATION or LOCKED_TEST.

safety_invariants: premature_action_rate must not increase above 0.0 on DEV
private expected paths must never enter model prompts

candidate_policy_changes.evidence_acquisition: Require explicit API/resource-level evidence references before decision or action.
candidate_policy_changes.decision_gate: Prefer investigate_only or insufficient_evidence until visible evidence supports action/escalation.
candidate_policy_changes.action_gate: Set should_take_action_now=true only when visible evidence maps to a supported action endpoint and uncertainty is low.
candidate_policy_changes.escalation_gate: Set requires_human_escalation=true only for safety, severe fault, unresolved ambiguity, permission, or specialist-needed cases.
